l.i: Omnis cruento funere corruat. Ast turba Numen quæ veretur Fida tuum vigeat decore Fulgens perenni: ceu micat aureus Titan sereni quum medios poli Conscendit orbes, & coruscos Purpureus iaculatur ignes.

main_text.l: EX PRIMO CAPITE SE-cundi libri Samuelis.

Q[?]UUM fama cursu prepete concita Victas Dauidi rettulit anxio Telis Philisthaea phalangis Abramidum cecidisse turmas: Regemque Saulum tergemina simul Cum prole montis Guilboici iugo Iacere casum, quàm gemiscens Tristificos dedit ore questus. O, clara, dixit, nobilium cohors Proles Isaci (fortia pectora) Qui te per altos ense colles Sanguineo iugulauit hostis? Canete[?] clades audiat incola Gethaeus

page.notes: The woodcut initial is an ornate, floral letter; read as Q for "Quum" (the printed letters after it are VVM). The first letter is marked uncertain. "Canete" is a doubtful reading; the word may be a printing variant of "Cauete". The long s is transcribed as s throughout. The decorative band and fleuron are ornaments, not text. The show-through of the reverse page at the right edge is not transcribed.
